senses.gloss: m. (preced.) physician, surgeon; also thaumaturg, [Essene, Therapeut?] Targ. Ex. XXI, 19; a. e.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:7:8">Y. Yoma III, 40ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חד א׳ וכ׳</he> a certain thaumaturg in Sepphoris.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:6:2">Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ</cite> <he>אוקיר לאסייך וכ׳</he> honor thy physician (with presents) ere thou be in need of him.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85a:21">B. Kam. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ רחיקא וכ׳</he> if the surgeon is far off, the eye will be blind (before he arrives).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:47">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>תרעא … לא׳</he> a door which opens not for charity, will be opened for the physician; a. fr. Pl. <cite ref="A02430"><he>אָסַיָּיא</he></cite>. Y. Naz. IX, end, 58ᵃ.—<he>אַסָוָותָא</he>, <cite ref="A02343"><he>אָסָוָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 50:2">Targ. Gen. L, 2</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:5">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דמַסְּיִין ליה וכ׳</he> physicians to cure R. Zadok.
